input.quote: then, as an alternative to its right to terminate this Agreement pursuant to Section 13.3 above, Ono may in its discretion elect to continue this Agreement, in which case (A) Ono shall be relieved of its due diligence obligations under this Agreement; and (B) as liquidated damages for the breaches described
input.rationale: The only liquidated-damages provision (Section 14.3) runs entirely in our favour: it is triggered by Array's breach or its concealment/falsification of material safety or efficacy data, relieves Ono of its diligence obligations, and reduces the otherwise applicable royalty rate as liquidated damages (p0671). Liquidated damages payable by the Vendor to the Customer are expressly compliant under this rule, so no redline is warranted. We found no Customer-payable penalty, minimum fee on termination, or early-termination fee anywhere in the Agreement: Article XIV imposes only transition/wind-down obligations on Ono, and the only other payment-default mechanic is the mutual late-payment interest in Section 7.1 (one-month LIBOR/interbank rate plus a margin), which is a commercial interest rate rather than a penalty for non-performance. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer).
